#include <iostream>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;
const long long INV2 = (MOD + 1) / 2; // modular inverse of 2

long long modPow(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
    long long result = 1 % mod;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    long long n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    long long k = r - l;
    long long even = k / 2 + 1;
    long long odd = (k + 1) / 2;
    long long cells = n * m;
    if (cells % 2 == 1) {
        long long base = k + 1;
        cout << modPow(base, cells, MOD) << endl;
    } else {
        long long base1 = even + odd; // = k+1
        long long base2 = even - odd; // 0 or 1
        long long temp1 = modPow(base1, cells, MOD);
        long long temp2 = modPow(base2, cells, MOD);
        long long result = (temp1 + temp2) % MOD;
        result = (result * INV2) % MOD;
        cout << result << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
